title: Prove and release the fully automated auditable workflow
objective: Prove the installed supported unattended workflow with real independent roles and actual controlled GitHub completion, reproducible failure evidence, operator guidance and a pinned release.
inScope: Run the installed acceptance matrix in an independent consumer and migrated Fantasy Football integration; retain exact source, package, configuration, grant, task, session and intervention evidence.

Demonstrate a representative authorized dependent-task chain through actual isolated provider roles, native validation/review, GitHub publication, exact-head CI and controlled merge/DONE without routine handoffs.

Exercise restart, legal validation/review rework, duplicate work, provider unavailability, stale source/CI, policy denial/expiry/revocation, durable budgets and uncertain merge; explicitly identify simulated faults.
Provide redacted audit export and an independently exercised installation, configure, inspect, pause/drain, resume, exception and rollback procedure.

Publish a versioned immutable GitHub release under the accepted distribution channel after final independent reviews and actual acceptance evidence; preserve the pinned Fantasy Football consumer boundary and cross-link roadmap/extraction/API scope.
outOfScope: Distributed deployment, new lifecycle authority, embedded consumer engine, arbitrary issue admission, weakened protection or role isolation, fake-only proof, a retired live canary requirement, npm publication, or claiming general autonomy for ambiguous work.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: A real authorized dependent-task chain completes through exact-head controlled merge/DONE with zero routine human handoffs after the initial grant.
AC-02: All required role judgments are independently sourced from fresh role contexts and validated against the final revision.
AC-03: Restart, rework and uncertain-outcome tests preserve audit history and avoid duplicate effects; failures do not become PASS.
AC-04: Policy-denied/expired/revoked or over-budget work stops with an actionable durable reason and no unauthorized effects.
AC-05: A fresh operator can install, configure, inspect audit evidence, pause/drain, resume and safely roll back using docs alone.
AC-06: Fantasy Football remains a pinned consumer with no embedded engine, and release evidence distinguishes M1 extraction from achieved M2 automation.
validationPlan: Run all README fresh-checkout checks, installed package conformance, exact-head GitHub CI and independent QA, Architecture and UAT/Product acceptance.
Pack and inspect the exact committed artifact; record SHA-256/SHA-512 and verify installed bytes before each acceptance scenario.
Complete a real dependent chain with fresh isolated Developer/QA/Architect/UAT contexts, actual native gates, real remote PR/CI/merge and replay after DONE; count every actual human intervention.
Exercise bounded faults with explicit real-versus-simulated labels and demonstrate no duplicate effects, hidden reset, fabricated pass or unauthorized action.
Have a fresh reviewer follow the operator documentation, inspect redacted evidence, exercise controls and rehearse stopped rollback with history hashes.
Verify migrated Fantasy Football is pinned with no embedded engine; retain migration and automation capability boundaries separately.
